ABOUT THE FUNDRAISER

Why we made this album

Kansas City is overflowing with generosity right now — food drives, hygiene drives, school support, pantry volunteers — but the need has outpaced the resources. Families are slipping through the cracks in ways most people never see.

Rogue Round Table launched We Want a Chiefs Christmas to close those gaps with flexible funding that can be used exactly where shortages are happening in real time.

  • Fresh food is arriving spoiled or unusable.
  • Pantries report no meat, dairy, butter, or formula.
  • Homeless outreach teams can’t get soft foods for people without teeth.
  • School snack programs and kid-friendly items are running dry.

This album is our way of saying “thank you” to KC for always showing up — and turning that gratitude into full carts, warm meals, and a little extra joy under the tree.

Where your donation goes

We work with Kansas City partners to stretch every dollar further, focusing on the gaps other programs can’t always cover in time.

  • Fresh food delivered quickly — before it spoils on shelves.
  • Soft foods and essentials for unhoused neighbors.
  • Snacks and support for kids so they can focus on learning, not hunger.
  • Micro-grants and restocks for KC pantries and outreach teams.
